lines.en: Thank you both for coming. We need to talk about next year's marketing budget.
lines.zh: 謝謝兩位來開會。我們要談談明年的行銷預算。

lines.en: I have the numbers here. We spent too much on the trade fair this year.
lines.zh: 數字我帶來了。我們今年在商展上花太多了。

lines.en: But the fair brought us many new customers, Ms. Carter.
lines.zh: 可是商展帶來很多新客戶，Ms. Carter。

lines.en: That is true, Dan. How many of them bought something?
lines.zh: 那倒是真的，Dan。他們之中有多少人買了東西？

lines.en: About thirty. Most of them are small shops.
lines.zh: 大約三十個。大部分是小店。

lines.en: Thirty is good, but the fair cost almost half of our budget.
lines.zh: 三十個是不錯，但商展花了我們快一半的預算。

lines.en: Then let's go to the fair again, but with a smaller table and fewer workers.
lines.zh: 那我們明年再去商展，不過用小一點的桌子、少一點的人。

lines.en: That would save about five thousand dollars. I will make a new plan today.
lines.zh: 那樣大約能省五千元。我今天就做新的計畫。

lines.en: And I will ask the fair office about a cheaper table.
lines.zh: 我會去問商展辦公室有沒有比較便宜的桌子。

questions.en: What is the main topic of this meeting?
questions.zh: 這場會議主要在談什麼？

questions.en: What problem does the accountant see with the fair?
questions.zh: 會計認為商展有什麼問題？

questions.en: What will the accountant do today?
questions.zh: 會計今天要做什麼？

lines.en: The contract is ready, Mr. Ellis. Please read page three first.
lines.zh: 合約準備好了，Mr. Ellis。請先看第三頁。

lines.en: I see a problem. The delivery time is ninety days, but our client needs the goods in sixty.
lines.zh: 我看到一個問題。交貨時間是九十天，但我們的客戶要在六十天內拿到貨。

lines.en: That is right. My new store opens in two months, so sixty days is the longest I can wait.
lines.zh: 沒錯。我的新店兩個月後開幕，所以我最多只能等六十天。

lines.en: Can your factory make the goods faster?
lines.zh: 你們的工廠能做快一點嗎？

lines.en: Yes, but we would need more workers, and that costs more money.
lines.zh: 可以，但我們需要更多工人，那會多花一些錢。

lines.en: I can pay a little more if the goods arrive on time.
lines.zh: 如果貨準時到，我可以多付一點。

lines.en: Then let's say sixty days, with a small extra cost.
lines.zh: 那就說六十天，另外加一小筆費用。

lines.en: Good. I will change page three, and you can sign tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: 好。我會修改第三頁，你們明天早上就可以簽。

questions.en: What problem does the director find in the contract?
questions.zh: 總經理在合約裡發現什麼問題？
options: The delivery time is too long.

questions.en: What will the client do if the goods arrive on time?
questions.zh: 如果貨準時到，客戶會怎麼做？

questions.en: When can the contract be signed?
questions.zh: 合約什麼時候可以簽？

lines.en: Welcome to our factory. Please wear this yellow hat during the tour.
lines.zh: 歡迎來到我們的工廠。參觀期間請戴這頂黃色帽子。

lines.en: Thank you. How many lamps do you make here every day?
lines.zh: 謝謝。你們這裡每天做多少盞燈？

lines.en: About two thousand. This line makes the basic model, and the next one makes the new model.
lines.zh: 大約兩千盞。這條線做基本款，下一條做新款。

lines.en: The new model looks very nice. Can I see how it is made?
lines.zh: 新款看起來很棒。我可以看它是怎麼做的嗎？

lines.en: Of course, but please stay behind the line on the floor. The machines are very hot.
lines.zh: 當然可以，不過請站在地上的線後面。機器很燙。

lines.en: I understand. Does every lamp get a quality check?
lines.zh: 我了解。每盞燈都會做品質檢查嗎？

lines.en: Yes. Two workers check each lamp, and we send back any lamp that does not work.
lines.zh: 會。兩位工人檢查每一盞燈，不亮的燈我們會退回去重做。

lines.en: That is good to hear. I would like to order five hundred of the new model.
lines.zh: 聽到這個很好。我想訂五百盞新款。

questions.en: What does the plant manager ask the visitor to do at the start?
questions.zh: 廠長一開始請訪客做什麼？

questions.en: Why must the visitor stay behind the line?
questions.zh: 為什麼訪客必須站在線後面？

questions.en: How many lamps will the client order?
questions.zh: 客戶要訂幾盞燈？

lines.en: Good morning, everyone. This is Ms. Reed from the human resources office.
lines.zh: 大家早安。我是人資部的 Ms. Reed。

lines.en: Next month we will start a wellness week for all workers.
lines.zh: 下個月我們要為所有員工辦一個健康週。

lines.en: Every day after lunch, there will be a short walk around the park, and on Thursday a doctor will talk about sleep.
lines.zh: 每天午餐後會有一段繞公園的短暫散步，星期四有一位醫生來談睡眠。

lines.en: Anyone who joins all five days will get a free water bottle.
lines.zh: 五天都參加的人會得到一個免費的水壺。

lines.en: Please sign up at the front desk before the end of this week.
lines.zh: 請在本週結束前到櫃台報名。

questions.en: Why is the speaker making this announcement?
questions.zh: 說話的人為什麼發布這則公告？
options: To ask for a new doctor.
To tell workers about a wellness week.

questions.en: How can a worker get a free water bottle?
questions.zh: 員工要怎麼得到免費的水壺？
options: Bring a friend to the park.
Join every day of the week.

questions.en: What should workers do before the end of this week?
questions.zh: 員工在本週結束前應該做什麼？
options: Sign up at the front desk.

lines.en: Hello, this is Nina. I have news about the magazine article for your lamp.
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Nina。我有雜誌上那篇燈具報導的消息。

lines.en: The reporter loves the new design and wants to visit your office on Tuesday.
lines.zh: 記者很喜歡新的設計，想在星期二去你們的辦公室。

lines.en: She will take some photos, so please clean the front room and put the new lamp on a table.
lines.zh: 她會拍一些照片，所以請把前面的房間整理乾淨，並把新燈放在桌上。

lines.en: She also wants to ask the director a few questions. It should take about twenty minutes.
lines.zh: 她還想問總經理幾個問題，大約需要二十分鐘。

lines.en: Please call me back today, so I can tell her the time.
lines.zh: 請今天回電給我，這樣我才能告訴她時間。

questions.en: Why is Nina calling?
questions.zh: Nina 為什麼打電話？
options: To tell about a visit from a reporter.
To ask for a photo of the office.
To say the new lamp is late.

questions.en: What does Nina ask the listener to prepare?
questions.zh: Nina 請聽的人準備什麼？
options: The front room and the new lamp.

questions.en: What does Nina want the listener to do today?
questions.zh: Nina 希望聽的人今天做什麼？

lines.en: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to our annual meeting.
lines.zh: 各位晚安，歡迎來到我們的年會。

lines.en: This year was a very good one for our company. Sales grew by twelve percent, and we opened a new office in Taichung.
lines.zh: 今年對我們公司來說非常好。銷售成長了百分之十二，我們還在 Taichung 開了一間新辦公室。

lines.en: I want to thank every worker for the hard work.
lines.zh: 我要感謝每一位員工的辛勤工作。

lines.en: Next year, we plan to start two new products and hire twenty new workers.
lines.zh: 明年我們打算推出兩項新產品，並新聘二十位員工。

lines.en: Before dinner, we will give three prizes to the workers who helped our customers the most.
lines.zh: 晚餐前，我們要頒三個獎給最會幫助客戶的員工。

lines.en: Please enjoy the evening, and thank you again.
lines.zh: 祝大家今晚愉快，再次謝謝大家。

questions.en: What grew by twelve percent this year?
questions.zh: 今年什麼成長了百分之十二？

questions.en: What will happen before dinner?
questions.zh: 晚餐前會發生什麼事？

questions.en: What does the company plan to do next year?
questions.zh: 公司明年打算做什麼？

lines.en: Hello, everyone. I have good news about our branch office.
lines.zh: 大家好。我有分公司的好消息要宣布。

lines.en: Starting next month, Dan will be our new team leader. He has worked here for six years, and our customers like him very much.
lines.zh: 從下個月開始，Dan 會成為我們的新組長。他在這裡工作六年了，客戶都很喜歡他。

lines.en: Also, the head office will visit us on the fifth. It is not a test, so please do not worry.
lines.zh: 另外，總公司會在五號來拜訪我們。這不是考試，所以請不用擔心。

lines.en: If you have a question about the new job, please see me after lunch.
lines.zh: 如果你對這個新職務有問題，請在午餐後來找我。

questions.en: What is the main news in this talk?
questions.zh: 這段話的主要消息是什麼？

questions.en: What does the speaker mean by "It is not a test"?
questions.zh: 說話的人說「這不是考試」是什麼意思？
options: Workers do not need to worry.

questions.en: When can workers ask the speaker about the new job?
questions.zh: 員工什麼時候可以向說話的人詢問新職務？

lines.en: Thank you for joining us, Nina. Both Dan and I need help with the presentation for Friday.
lines.zh: 謝謝你加入我們，Nina。Dan 和我需要你幫忙準備星期五的簡報。

lines.en: Of course, Ms. Carter. Who will be at the meeting?
lines.zh: 當然，Ms. Carter。會議上會有哪些人？

lines.en: Mr. Ellis and two clients from Taichung. They want to see our plan for the new lamp.
lines.zh: Mr. Ellis 和兩位來自Taichung 的客戶。他們想看我們新燈的計畫。

lines.en: I made twelve slides, but I think that is too many.
lines.zh: 我做了十二張投影片，不過我覺得太多了。

lines.en: Yes, I think so. Ten minutes is short, so please use only six slides, with big pictures and few words.
lines.zh: 對，我也這麼覺得。十分鐘很短，所以只用六張，用大張的圖片和少少的字。

lines.en: That sounds good. Should I put the price on the first slide?
lines.zh: 聽起來不錯。我要把價錢放在第一張嗎？

lines.en: No, show the price last. First, tell them why customers need the lamp.
lines.zh: 不要，價錢放最後。先告訴他們客戶為什麼需要這盞燈。

lines.en: Good idea. Please change the slides tonight, Dan, and we will practice tomorrow at nine.
lines.zh: 好主意。請今晚修改投影片，Dan，我們明天九點練習。

questions.en: What are the speakers getting ready for?
questions.zh: 說話的人在為什麼做準備？

questions.en: What does Nina suggest about the slides?
questions.zh: Nina 對投影片有什麼建議？
options: Use fewer slides with big pictures.
Use more slides with more words.
Put the price on the first slide.

questions.en: When will the team practice the talk?
questions.zh: 團隊什麼時候練習簡報？

lines.en: Mr. Ellis, Ms. Carter, thank you for meeting with me about the new sales leader job.
lines.zh: Mr. Ellis、Ms. Carter，謝謝你們來和我談新的業務主管職缺。

lines.en: We have two choices. One is Dan, who knows our customers well. The other is a worker from the Taichung office.
lines.zh: 我們有兩個選擇。一位是 Dan，他很了解我們的客戶。另一位是Taichung 辦公室的員工。

lines.en: I like Dan very much, but I think he needs more training before he can lead a big team.
lines.zh: 我很喜歡 Dan，不過我覺得他要先多受一些訓練，才能帶大團隊。

lines.en: The worker from Taichung has led a team before, but she does not know our products.
lines.zh: Taichung 的那位以前帶過團隊，但她不了解我們的產品。

lines.en: Then why don't we give the job to Dan, and send him to a leadership class later this year?
lines.zh: 那我們何不把職缺給 Dan，今年稍後再送他去上領導課？

lines.en: I agree. He will learn fast.
lines.zh: 我同意。他學得很快。

lines.en: I will write to him today. When should the new job start?
lines.zh: 我今天會寫信給他。新職務應該什麼時候開始？

lines.en: At the start of next month, so he has time to finish his old work.
lines.zh: 下個月初，這樣他才有時間做完手上的工作。

questions.en: What are the speakers trying to decide?
questions.zh: 說話的人正在決定什麼？
options: Where to open a new office.
Who should lead the sales team.
Which class to hold next year.
How much to pay a new worker.

questions.en: What does Ms. Carter think about Dan?
questions.zh: Ms. Carter 覺得 Dan 怎麼樣？
options: He has led a big team.
He does not know the customers.

questions.en: What will the speaker from human resources do today?
questions.zh: 人資的說話者今天會做什麼？

lines.en: Welcome to the first day of our training. Today we will learn how to use the new machine safely.
lines.zh: 歡迎來到訓練的第一天。今天我們要學怎麼安全地使用新機器。

lines.en: Great. Do I need to wear anything special?
lines.zh: 太好了。我需要穿戴什麼特別的東西嗎？

lines.en: Yes. Always wear gloves and glasses, and keep your bag away from the machine.
lines.zh: 要。一定要戴手套和眼鏡，包包要離機器遠一點。

lines.en: What should I do if the machine stops?
lines.zh: 如果機器停了，我該怎麼辦？

lines.en: Do not touch it. Press the red button and call me right away.
lines.zh: 不要碰它。按下紅色按鈕，馬上叫我。

lines.en: I understand. How long is the training?
lines.zh: 我明白了。訓練有多久？

lines.en: Three days. On the last day, you will take a short test, and then you can start work on Monday.
lines.zh: 三天。最後一天要考一個短測驗，然後你星期一就可以開始工作。

lines.en: That is faster than I thought. Thank you.
lines.zh: 比我想的還快。謝謝你。

questions.en: What is this training about?
questions.zh: 這個訓練是關於什麼？

questions.en: What should the new worker do if the machine stops?
questions.zh: 如果機器停了，新員工該怎麼做？

questions.en: What will happen on the last day of training?
questions.zh: 訓練的最後一天會發生什麼事？
options: The worker will meet the director.
The worker will take a test.
The worker will buy some gloves.
The worker will use the machine alone.

lines.en: Welcome to the city trade fair. The doors are open from nine to six today and tomorrow.
lines.zh: 歡迎來到市商展。今天和明天的開放時間是九點到六點。

lines.en: If you are looking for a supplier, please visit the blue hall, where you can see more than one hundred tables.
lines.zh: 如果您在找供應商，請到藍廳，那裡有一百多張攤位桌。

lines.en: Free samples are in the red hall, and food is on the second floor.
lines.zh: 免費樣品在紅廳，餐飲在二樓。

lines.en: A talk on new markets starts at two o'clock in room four.
lines.zh: 關於新市場的講座兩點在四號室開始。

lines.en: Please keep your name card with you, and thank you for coming.
lines.zh: 請隨身帶著您的名牌，謝謝您的光臨。

questions.en: Where can visitors find suppliers?
questions.zh: 訪客可以在哪裡找到供應商？

questions.en: What will happen at two o'clock?
questions.zh: 兩點會發生什麼事？

questions.en: How long is the fair open today?
questions.zh: 商展今天開放多久？

lines.en: Hello, this is a message for Ms. Carter about your last order of glass.
lines.zh: 你好，這是給 Ms. Carter 的留言，關於你們上一次訂的玻璃。

lines.en: I am sorry, but the glass will not arrive on Tuesday as we planned.
lines.zh: 很抱歉，玻璃不能照我們原本計畫的在星期二送到。

lines.en: A machine at our factory is broken, and the repair will take two days.
lines.zh: 我們工廠的一台機器壞了，修理要兩天。

lines.en: The glass will come on Thursday morning instead, and I will not charge you for the delivery.
lines.zh: 玻璃會改在星期四早上送到，而且送貨費我不收。

lines.en: If Thursday is a problem, please call me at the office before noon today.
lines.zh: 如果星期四不方便，請在今天中午前打電話到辦公室找我。

questions.en: Why is the speaker leaving this message?
questions.zh: 說話的人為什麼留這則訊息？
options: To ask for a new order.
To change the price of glass.
To say an order will be late.

questions.en: Why will the glass be late?
questions.zh: 玻璃為什麼會晚到？

questions.en: What does the speaker offer?
questions.zh: 說話的人提供了什麼？

lines.en: Hello, and thank you for coming to our job day.
lines.zh: 大家好，謝謝你們來參加我們的徵才日。

lines.en: I will tell you about our open jobs. We need two sales workers and one accountant.
lines.zh: 我來說明我們的職缺。我們需要兩位業務和一位會計。

lines.en: Sales workers should like to talk with people, and the accountant should be good with numbers.
lines.zh: 業務要喜歡和人交談，會計要擅長處理數字。

lines.en: Please leave your resume at the front table, and our team will call you within one week.
lines.zh: 請把履歷留在前面的桌子上，我們的團隊會在一週內打電話給你。

lines.en: The first interviews will be next Wednesday in the large meeting room.
lines.zh: 第一輪面試在下星期三，地點是大會議室。

lines.en: If you have any questions, I will be at the door after this talk.
lines.zh: 如果你有任何問題，這場說明結束後我會在門口。

questions.en: Who is the speaker talking to?
questions.zh: 說話的人在對誰說話？

questions.en: What does the speaker ask the listeners to do?
questions.zh: 說話的人請聽眾做什麼？
options: Leave a resume at the front table.

questions.en: When will the first interviews take place?
questions.zh: 第一輪面試什麼時候舉行？

lines.en: Good afternoon, everyone. I have two changes to tell you about before the weekend.
lines.zh: 大家午安。週末前我有兩項異動要告訴大家。

lines.en: First, the factory will close early on Friday at three o'clock, because the new machine will arrive and we need a clear floor.
lines.zh: 第一，星期五工廠會在三點提早關門，因為新機器要到了，我們需要把場地清空。

lines.en: Second, a bus will take workers to the Taichung office on Saturday for a dinner with the director.
lines.zh: 第二，星期六會有巴士載員工到Taichung 辦公室，參加和總經理的晚餐。

lines.en: Your families are welcome. Please tell me by tomorrow if yours will come, so the office can order enough food.
lines.zh: 歡迎帶家人一起來。請在明天前告訴我你的家人會不會來，這樣辦公室才能訂足夠的餐點。

lines.en: Thank you, and have a good weekend.
lines.zh: 謝謝大家，祝週末愉快。

questions.en: Why will the factory close early on Friday?
questions.zh: 星期五工廠為什麼要提早關門？

questions.en: Who is welcome at the dinner on Saturday?
questions.zh: 星期六的晚餐歡迎誰參加？

questions.en: What must workers tell the speaker by tomorrow?
questions.zh: 員工要在明天前告訴說話的人什麼事？
